svg.text: KV cache: read by the unit
One token: forward() for each of the n_layers layers, then the classifier

The prompt comes from host/chat.py over the UART; the CPU encodes it and feeds its tokens through forward() before generating. The CPU orchestrates: it starts the jobs and does RMSNorm, RoPE and the residual adds.
The float operations are runq.c's, in runq.c's order (no FMA): the board's logits are bit-identical to the x86 build of the same firmware.
